raw.title: Managing Director
raw.description:
Description

Valsoft specialises in acquiring and growing vertical market software companies. Our mission is to provide a permanent home for software businesses, preserving the legacy of their founders while investing in the long-term growth and success of the companies we acquire. We operate and manage a global portfolio of wholly owned software businesses, delivering mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry best practices, Valsoft ensures a time-sensitive integration process and operates a decentralised model, fostering rapid growth through reinvestment in its portfolio.   

The Role:   

This position provides critical operational leadership to a company and potentially a portfolio of companies within a growing software vertical. As the leader of a company, you will be responsible for developing and implementing the business’s strategic plan across all major functions, including sales and marketing, R&D, customer service, professional services, and human resources.   

You will work closely with the leadership team to identify, define, and execute strategies required to achieve growth plans and operating objectives, with a focus on improving operational excellence. This role carries full accountability for the company's results, making it ideal for a driven leader eager to make a significant impact.   

Key Responsibilities:   

  • Own the long-range, annual, and quarterly financial and non-financial goals  
  • Develop and communicate a clear vision of goals and objectives, strategies, and philosophies about growth, revenue generation, profitability, and customer care  
  • Manage day-to-day operations, including sales performance, opportunity management, forecasting, R&D capacity, and customer support  
  • Attend promotional events which include but not limited to tradeshows and panels  

Sales and Marketing   

  • Drive revenue growth, working with the sales team to identify new opportunities and execute growth strategies including cross/upsell and entering adjacent markets     
  • Develop and implement best in class sales operations and sales infrastructure to enable effective scale and ensure process discipline     
  • Develop and maintain competitive intelligence programs, generating industry trend reports to inform new feature and product development    
  • Improve use of Salesforce and other internal tools to increase forecasting capability, implement targets, and provide actionable insights to executive team and board of directors    
  • Create and implement KPIs for sales team to measure performance and productivity (ex: CAC / LTV) ; develop performance dashboards and establish reporting process (measure NRR and MRR trends)    
  • Work with sales leaders in establishing quotas, budgets, compensation plans and pricing optimization    
  • Manage key relationships with large accounts is mandatory    

Customer Care/Customer Success:  

  • Execute an effective, long-term customer success program for clients    
  • Implement and maintain client support initiatives    
  • Facilitate both in-house and client training sessions    
  • Monitor and document Customer Success metrics, including program usage, satisfaction levels, ticket throughput, and resolution    
  • Coordinate the administration of annual customer satisfaction surveys (NPS) and other communication tools    

Research and Development:    

  • Ensure clear product roadmaps are established, followed, and adapted to meet market needs    
  • Balance investment in R&D with maintenance efforts to maximize new customer growth and retain existing clients while maintaining efficient Customer Care and R&D operations    
  • Track Product Manager prioritization of R&D tasks, ensuring they are entered into the corporate system and executed by software developers    
  • Facilitate the growth of Product Managers by aligning their activities with job descriptions    

Professional services:    

  • Ensure we are delivering profitable projects by monitoring billable utilizations, staff OPEX and contribution margin    
  • Establish strategies to increase NRR    
  • Track on a monthly basis results with the Head of Professional Services    

Financial Management:    

  • Review with Senior Management and the team:    
  • Advance performance by driving improvements in revenue, profit, customer retention, loss prevention, and expense ratios    
  • Annual, quarterly, and monthly revenue results/forecasts and costs    
  • Participate in the development of internal department policies and programs to support quality and growth    
  • Drive P&L, ROI, EBITDA, rule of 40 and ARR/ IRR performance of businesses and ensure companies are meeting organizational objectives    

Human resources:    

  • Partnering with your HR lead in driving talent retention and development, complying with local employment legislation and developing a true local company culture   

Growth through M&A:  

  • Engage in M&A activities, working closely with the Valsoft investment group on acquisition strategy and M&A initiatives  
  • Oversee post-acquisition initiatives to integrate companies into your business, focusing on operational transformation and implementation of efficiencies  

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Proven experience in senior leadership roles within the software or technology sector
  • Strong skills in developing and executing strategic business plans across multiple functions
  • Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth and market expansion
  • Hands-on approach to managing daily operations and improving operational excellence
  • Proven track record in leading change management initiatives — bringing teams through restructuring, process redesign, or new ways of working with clarity and buy-in
  • Practical understanding of AI and its application to software products and internal operations, with the ability to translate emerging technology into concrete business value and to drive adoption across the organisation
  • Exceptional leadership with the ability to inspire and manage cross-functional teams through periods of transformation
  • Results-oriented with a focus on achieving targets and continuous improvement
  • Strong commitment to customer success and care
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for influencing stakeholders and building support for change at all levels
  • Innovative, proactive, and adaptable with a collaborative mindset
  • Full professional proficiency in English (required)
  • Legally authorized to work in Germany / Switzerland / Austria / France

raw.title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
raw.description:
About us

UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.
Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.

At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.


Your mission

You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.


Your profile

  • You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.
  • You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).
  • You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.
  • You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.
  • You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.

How we work
We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.

Potential Research Directions
These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.
1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.
2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.
3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.

Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own.


What we offer

  • Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors.
  • Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events.
  • Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship.
  • Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.
  • Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.
  • AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.
  • Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.

Interested?
Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!


Diversity is important to us

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.

www.uvcpartners.com

  • You automate data analytics and insights visualizations that are applicable and interpretable by non-technical users, helping researchers and brand managers work with advanced methods without needing technical expertise

  • You automate the application of advanced market research methods that are easy to use while being statistically and scientifically valid

  • You build and ship machine learning models (supervised, unsupervised, LLM-based) end-to-end — from prototyping and training to production deployment in our platform

  • You contribute to our AI observability and evaluation practices, working with tools like Langfuse and inspect-ai to monitor, trace, and continuously improve our AI systems in production

BigQuery, angebunden an Shopify, Klaviyo und weitere Quellen) und sorgst dafür, dass Kennzahlen zuverlässig, aktuell und zentral verfügbar sind. Mit deinem Marktverständnis platzierst du unser Portfolio gezielt und trägst aktiv zum Unternehmenserfolg bei.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du entwickelst und verantwortest den Vertrieb von Infrastruktur- und Service-Lösungen bei Neu- und Bestandskunden im Public Sector, speziell bei IT-Dienstleistern in Norddeutschland 
  • Du identifizierst Geschäftspotenziale, baust belastbare Kundenbeziehungen auf und erreichst die vereinbarten Vertriebsziele
  • Du steuerst Ausschreibungen und Angebotsprozesse ganzheitlich, von der Bid-Strategie über die Kalkulation bis zur Präsentation beim Kunden
  • Du führst proaktive Vertriebs- und Kundenkampagnen durch und platzierst unser Portfolio gezielt bei relevanten Entscheidungsträgern
  • Du bereitest Kundentermine vor Ort und remote vor, führst diese eigenständig durch und überführst identifizierte Bedarfe in konkrete Verkaufschancen
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Bid Management, PreSales, Delivery und externen Partnern zusammen, um optimale Kundenlösungen zu entwickeln
  • Du dokumentierst Vertriebsaktivitäten im CRM, stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sicher und berichtest regelmäßig zu deinen Accounts und Opportunities


Das bringst du mit

  • Du verfügst über mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Sales, Account Management oder in einer vergleichbaren vertriebsnahen Funktion
  • Du kannst nachweisbare Vertriebserfolge vorweisen und hast Freude daran, neue Geschäftspotenziale zu identifizieren und auszubauen
  • Du kennst den Public Sector in Norddeutschland, idealerweise mit Kontakten im Bereich der öffentlichen IT-Dienstleistern
  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse im Vertrieb von Rechenzentrumsinfrastruktur sowie ein gutes Verständnis für den Betrieb von Rechenzentren mit
  • Du kennst die aktuellen Digitalisierungsthemen und Entwicklungen im Public Sector und kannst diese in Kundengesprächen adressieren
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Vergabeverfahren und Ausschreibungen und bewegst dich sicher im Umfeld des öffentlichen Einkaufs
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine proaktive, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit, in unserem Office in Hamburg oder vor Ort beim Kunden.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
  
Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.

Federica Santandrea

Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. 
Du hast weitreichende Projekterfahrung in unterschiedlichen Kontexten gesammelt und große Projekte erfolgreich geleitet? Dann suchen wir Dich als (Senior) Project Manager (all genders), um mit uns gemeinsam digitale Lösungen für die eSociety zu realisieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst große IT-Projekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz – agil, klassisch oder hybrid
  • Mit deinem interdisziplinären Team übersetzt Du Kundenanforderungen in neue und bestehende IT-Lösungen und –Prozesse, in Agilen Projekt-Setups agierst du dabei als Product Owner
  • Du setzt Projekte in einem vielfältigen technologischen Umfeld um – von Content und Formular Management Systemen (CMS, FMS) über Lowcode-Plattformen, Entwicklung individueller Fachanwendungen bis hin zu Workplace-Lösungen
  • Du begleitest unsere Kunden über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit zu Fragen der digitalen Transformation und berätst zu Lösungen aus dem ]init[-Portfolio
  • Du übernimmst die Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und das Schnittstellenmanagement zwischen verschiedenen internen und externen Stakeholdern
  • Du bringst deine Stärken in der Gestaltung & Moderation von Workshops mit Kunden ein und entwickelst Strategien zur effizienten Umsetzung digitaler Lösungen
  • Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in der Zusammenarbeit nach intern und extern, erarbeitest zielgerichtete Handlungsempfehlungen und gestaltest Veränderungsprozesse proaktiv


Das bringst du mit

  • Websites, Intranets, Apps, digitale Antragssysteme oder Fachanwendungen: Du begeisterst dich für die Umsetzung von herausragenden IT-Projekten
  • Du hast 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von IT-Projekten gesammelt und kannst eigenständig Projekte leiten
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen oder klassischen Projektmethoden und rundest mit einer Zertifizierung idealerweise dein Profil ab (z.B. PMI/CAPM, Prince2, Scrum PSPO/PSM)
  • Du hast Freude an komplexen technischen Fragestellungen, am Austausch mit Kunden und bringst ein Gespür für deren Bedürfnisse mit und hast sich daraus ergebende Vertriebspotentiale immer im Blick
  • Mit Deinem Kommunikationsgeschick bewegst Du Dich souverän auf allen Ebenen der Projektorganisation, vermittelst komplexe Themen klar und adressatengerecht
  • Du besitzt ein abgeschlossenes Studium 
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
 
Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.

Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie. Du wirst eng mit dem Enterprise Architect, dem IT Governance Analysten und dem Manager Trust & Security zusammenarbeiten, um die IT-Strategie, Standards und Leitplanken zu definieren. So ermöglichst du es den tonies-Mitarbeitenden, unserer wachsenden globalen Kundenbasis effektiv sichere und stabile Produkte mit einem skalierbaren Fundament zu bieten. Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der organisiert, zuverlässig und lernbegierig ist sowie Interesse daran hat, eine Karriere im IT-Bereich in einem internationalen Umfeld aufzubauen. Deine Aufgaben umfassen: IT-Strategie & Architektur Bewerten der tonies-Systemlandschaft im Hinblick auf den strategischen Fit. Unterstützen strategischer IT-Projekte (z. B. Stammdatenmanagement, Lizenzgebühren/Royalties, E-Commerce). Pflegen der Enterprise-Architektur-Dokumentation in LeanIX. IT-Governance & Sicherheit Vorqualifizieren neuer Software-Anfragen und Beraten fachübergreifender Stakeholder (IT, Data/AI, Einkauf, Legal). Pflegen des tonies-Applikationsportfolios (System Ownership, CIA-Scoring, Kosten, Nutzung etc.). Optimieren von Verlängerungsprozessen durch Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Aktualisierung des Softwarelizenz-Verlängerungsplans. Aufsetzen und iteratives Weiterentwickeln von IT-Security-Onlinetrainingsmodulen für Mitarbeitende. Unterstützen von ISO 27001-, ITIL- und allgemeinen Compliance-Initiativen. title: Backend Engineer - Data & Orchestration
description: Who we are Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 3 billion minutes worldwide. Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR. What you will do Everything we ship runs on data, and the systems that collect, move and store that data need an owner. As Backend Engineer - Data & Orchestration, you take a data platform that grew fast and turn it into one system the whole company can rely on. You keep it running, you keep it clean, and you make it simpler every month. This is not a pure ETL or warehouse role: you work across the pipelines and the backend services they depend on. We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include: Data collection: keeping our scrapers and platform integrations running across flaky sources, rate limits, anti-bot measures and APIs that change overnight Pipelines and storage: owning our event-driven pipelines end to end, from orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar) to databases and warehouses, built to survive failures and to keep costs in check Monitoring and reliability: building the monitoring and alerting (Datadog or similar) that keeps our services and integrations healthy, and the checks on freshness, volume, schema and values that catch a wrong number before anyone downstream notices Backend services: working on the production services and APIs our data flows through, including our JavaScript backends Infrastructure and security: owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and cloud for our data systems, plus access and secrets: who and what can reach which system, including AI tools Simplification: consolidating what grew fast into one documented system, and removing what is no longer needed Working across the team: explaining what the data can and cannot do to non-technical colleagues, and guiding junior engineers as the team grows Who you are We are looking for an engineer who runs what they build, and builds things that keep running. You have operated real production systems in a small, fast-moving company, and people trust you with them. Typically, your profile will look like this: Experience: 3 to 10 years of hands-on engineering, most of it in small or fast-growing companies where you owned production systems yourself rather than handing them to a platform team Python and backend: advanced Python, including async code and long-running data jobs, and enough backend experience to work on production services and APIs, including basic JavaScript or TypeScript backends Scraping and data acquisition: you have kept unreliable external sources running in production (scrapers, platform APIs, unofficial endpoints) and you know how to handle proxies, rate limits and anti-bot measures; using LLMs to extract data from messy sources is a plus Pipelines and storage: you have designed and run event-driven, fault-tolerant pipelines handling millions of records a day, with Airflow, Dagster or task queues, on databases such as Postgres, ClickHouse, MongoDB or Redshift, and you know what they cost to run Data reliability and monitoring: your systems report their own problems through freshness, volume, schema and value checks, and you use Datadog or an equivalent to keep services and integrations reliable, because a wrong number that nobody noticed is the outcome you design against Infrastructure and security: you are comfortable with Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and cloud, and ideally you have run an access review and set up role-based access and secrets management Ownership and communication: you have owned a messy data setup end to end at a smaller company and left it simpler, documented and maintainable; you explain trade-offs to non-technical colleagues, push back when it matters, and have guided junior engineers or led a small team Engineering fundamentals: you learned to build solid systems before AI coding tools were everywhere, and today you use them to go faster, not to replace that judgment; you ship fast, keep the codebase clean, and take the time to understand the context before you build Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment What makes this exciting Our data systems feed everything the company does, and you own them outright. You are not maintaining someone else's legacy: you decide how these systems should work and you make them work that way. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 3 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

What you will do

Everything we ship runs on data, and the systems that collect, move and store that data need an owner. As Backend Engineer - Data & Orchestration, you take a data platform that grew fast and turn it into one system the whole company can rely on. You keep it running, you keep it clean, and you make it simpler every month. This is not a pure ETL or warehouse role: you work across the pipelines and the backend services they depend on. We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Data collection: keeping our scrapers and platform integrations running across flaky sources, rate limits, anti-bot measures and APIs that change overnight

  • Pipelines and storage: owning our event-driven pipelines end to end, from orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar) to databases and warehouses, built to survive failures and to keep costs in check

  • Monitoring and reliability: building the monitoring and alerting (Datadog or similar) that keeps our services and integrations healthy, and the checks on freshness, volume, schema and values that catch a wrong number before anyone downstream notices

  • Backend services: working on the production services and APIs our data flows through, including our JavaScript backends

  • Infrastructure and security: owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and cloud for our data systems, plus access and secrets: who and what can reach which system, including AI tools

  • Simplification: consolidating what grew fast into one documented system, and removing what is no longer needed

  • Working across the team: explaining what the data can and cannot do to non-technical colleagues, and guiding junior engineers as the team grows

Who you are

We are looking for an engineer who runs what they build, and builds things that keep running. You have operated real production systems in a small, fast-moving company, and people trust you with them.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

  • Experience: 3 to 10 years of hands-on engineering, most of it in small or fast-growing companies where you owned production systems yourself rather than handing them to a platform team

  • Python and backend: advanced Python, including async code and long-running data jobs, and enough backend experience to work on production services and APIs, including basic JavaScript or TypeScript backends

  • Scraping and data acquisition: you have kept unreliable external sources running in production (scrapers, platform APIs, unofficial endpoints) and you know how to handle proxies, rate limits and anti-bot measures; using LLMs to extract data from messy sources is a plus

  • Pipelines and storage: you have designed and run event-driven, fault-tolerant pipelines handling millions of records a day, with Airflow, Dagster or task queues, on databases such as Postgres, ClickHouse, MongoDB or Redshift, and you know what they cost to run

  • Data reliability and monitoring: your systems report their own problems through freshness, volume, schema and value checks, and you use Datadog or an equivalent to keep services and integrations reliable, because a wrong number that nobody noticed is the outcome you design against

  • Infrastructure and security: you are comfortable with Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and cloud, and ideally you have run an access review and set up role-based access and secrets management

  • Ownership and communication: you have owned a messy data setup end to end at a smaller company and left it simpler, documented and maintainable; you explain trade-offs to non-technical colleagues, push back when it matters, and have guided junior engineers or led a small team

  • Engineering fundamentals: you learned to build solid systems before AI coding tools were everywhere, and today you use them to go faster, not to replace that judgment; you ship fast, keep the codebase clean, and take the time to understand the context before you build

  • Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

Our data systems feed everything the company does, and you own them outright. You are not maintaining someone else's legacy: you decide how these systems should work and you make them work that way. title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Berlin)
description: GeneralMind is a Berlin-founded AI company building its own System of Action for modern enterprises: an operational AI layer on top of ERP systems. This is not a copilot. It's an autopilot: human-supervised, with approvals where needed. Our AI Autopilot autonomously executes recurring, complex workflows end-to-end across email, Excel, and enterprise systems. Incoming tasks are captured, analyzed, and completed with human-level capability, tracking handovers, meeting deadlines, and ensuring compliance across multiple stakeholders. Designed for mid-sized and large enterprises, GeneralMind helps organizations eliminate inbox-driven work, improve execution across goods and money flows, and keep supply chains moving at scale. Founded in 2025, GeneralMind serves customers across industry, commerce, and logistics in Europe and beyond. Tasks Test the platform from a real user's perspective, running through both typical flows and the unusual ones ("what happens if I enter the wrong thing?"). Track down bugs, crashes, display issues, and illogical behaviour, and document them clearly with steps to reproduce. Judge whether features work the way they should, and flag anything confusing, clunky, or inconsistent (usability). Check different devices, browsers, and screen sizes to make sure everything works everywhere. Rank bugs by severity (critical vs. cosmetic) and prioritise them so the team knows what to fix first. Retest fixed bugs and confirm that the fixes didn't break anything else (regression testing). Work closely with engineering and product, answer their questions, and help reproduce issues. Requirements A sharp, thorough eye for detail and the patience to get to the bottom of things. A structured, clear way of documenting bugs so anyone can follow them. The ability to think like a user and to use software "the wrong way" on purpose to find its limits. Clear, easy-to-understand communication, both written and spoken.   • 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst.

  • Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. 

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.  

  • Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.  

  • Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX.

Dein Profil Systemadministrator Linux

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten.  

  • Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.  

  • Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.  

  • Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen.  

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.  

  • Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren.  

  • Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil.

Im engen Austausch mit unserem M&A-Team, dem Head of M&A sowie unserem Management leistest Du damit einen direkten Beitrag zum weiteren Wachstum der Arsipa Gruppe. Dafür brauchen wir Deine Unterstützung! Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt – unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, People, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin. Deine Aufgaben: Steuerung von M&A-Transaktionen Buy-Side-Transaktionen steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich von der ersten Analyse bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Unternehmensbewertungen führst Du durch und entwickelst geeignete Transaktions- und Finanzierungsstrukturen. Angebote und relevante Transaktionsdokumente erstellst und verhandelst Du gemeinsam mit dem M&A-Team. Due-Diligence-Prozesse begleitest und koordinierst Du über die relevanten Fachbereiche hinweg. Deal Sourcing & Akquisitionsstrategie Potenzielle Akquisitionsziele identifizierst und analysierst Du mit besonderem Fokus auf den Health-, Safety- & Environment-Markt. Geeignete Zielunternehmen sprichst Du proaktiv an und entwickelst bestehende Kontakte im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie weiter. Markt- und Unternehmensanalysen nutzt Du, um attraktive Akquisitionsmöglichkeiten frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu bewerten. Strategische und wirtschaftliche Potenziale möglicher Akquisitionen beurteilst Du und bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für das Management vor. Projektsteuerung & Stakeholdermanagement Sämtliche am Transaktionsprozess beteiligten internen und externen Stakeholder koordinierst Du eigenständig und stellst einen strukturierten Deal-Prozess sicher. Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem M&A-Team, dem Head of M&A sowie CEO und CFO zusammen. Externe Berater:innen steuerst Du zielgerichtet und sorgst dafür, dass die relevanten Workstreams effizient zusammenlaufen. Transaktionsprozesse behältst Du hinsichtlich Zeitplan, Meilensteinen und relevanter Entscheidungsgrundlagen kontinuierlich im Blick. Deine Startvoraussetzungen: Das bringst Du mit: Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finance, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage. Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking oder einer vergleichbaren transaktionsnahen Tätigkeit bringst Du mit. Nachweisliche End-to-End-Deal-Erfahrung, idealerweise auf der Buy-Side, ermöglicht Dir die eigenständige Steuerung von Transaktionen. Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Projektsteuerung von Small- bis Mid-Cap-Transaktionen sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab. Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein: Erfahrung in einem Private-Equity- bzw. Buy-&-Build-Umfeld wäre von Vorteil. Kenntnisse im Health-, Safety-, Healthcare- oder Professional-Services-Umfeld wären ein Plus. Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführungen, Investor:innen und externen Transaktionsberater:innen ist wünschenswert. Eine strukturierte, analytische und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke helfen Dir, komplexe Transaktionsprozesse sicher zu steuern. Unsere Benefits: Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit großzügigen Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“. Ein Full-Remote-Setup innerhalb Deutschlands ist ebenfalls möglich. Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events fördert den fachlichen Austausch und eine positive, kollegiale Zusammenarbeit. Direkte Nähe zu Management und M&A: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of M&A, CEO und CFO sowie den Geschäftsführungen unserer Tochtergesellschaften ermöglicht Dir, Buy-Side-Transaktionen eigenverantwortlich zu begleiten und direkten Einfluss auf den Wachstumskurs der Arsipa Gruppe zu nehmen. Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform: Prozesse, Strukturen und Standards im M&A-Bereich gestaltest Du aktiv mit und erhältst unmittelbare Einblicke in die Umsetzung unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie - unterstützt durch Warburg Pincus. End-to-End-Verantwortung im Deal-Prozess: Von Deal Sourcing und Unternehmensbewertung über Due Diligence und Transaktionsstrukturierung bis hin zur Vertragsverhandlung und zum Closing übernimmst Du Verantwortung für zentrale Schritte unserer Buy-Side-Transaktionen. Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Kurzes Telefonat mit dem Group Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe. Interview mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen aus dem Fachbereich M&A. Persönliches Kennenlernen mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen aus dem Fachbereich M&A und dem Management. Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Dir gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung! raw.description:
Want a 3D Career? Join Norgine. 

At Norgine, our colleagues Dare themselves to be different and try new things, Drive to achieve their goals and beyond, and Develop themselves and their community.  

We call it the 3D career at Norgine and it offers you a fully-rounded experience with no limits.  

Bring everything about yourself that you’re proud of, whether that’s your passion for making a difference, focus on others’ well-being, or intellectual curiosity to unleash in a fast-paced environment and supportive community.  

In return, get a sense of belonging, a long-term career with ongoing development and upskilling, and a company that cares about people’s wellness as much as you do.  

Norgine: Transforming Healthcare, Backed by Over a Century of Expertise.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Senior Brand Lead DACH (Consumer Health) who combines strategic marketing expertise with strong commercial acumen and a passion for driving growth. In this highly visible role, you will be the local ambassador for our consumer health portfolio across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, leading the development and execution of brand and commercial strategies that maximize business performance and market impact.

Working closely with cross-functional teams and key external partners, you will take full ownership of the local business, ensuring the successful implementation of global strategies while identifying and unlocking opportunities tailored to local market needs. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our brands, inspiring teams, building strong customer relationships, and delivering sustainable growth in a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment.

Requirements

Financial Management

  • Drive sustainable growth by achieving agreed sales, profit and market share targets across the Consumer Healthcare portfolio.
  • Take full ownership of the local Brand P&L, ensuring efficient resource allocation and identifying opportunities to improve profitability.
  • Deliver key business KPIs, including financial performance, forecasting accuracy, market share growth and strategic project execution.
  • Optimize marketing and commercial investments to maximize return on investment and business impact.

Commercial Management

  • Lead the commercial strategy and execution across the DACH region to deliver profitable channel growth.
  • Manage relationships with distributors, customers and third-party partners, including contract negotiations and performance management.
  • Develop and implement effective route-to-market, trade and channel strategies to ensure optimal market coverage and commercial success.
  • Drive e-commerce and digital growth initiatives in line with the global digital strategy.
  • Monitor commercial performance, identify opportunities and implement corrective actions where required.
  • Equip sales teams and external partners with the tools, insights and support needed to achieve business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensure high levels of engagement with Norgine brands.

Consumer Marketing

  • Adapt and implement global brand strategies to meet local market needs and drive market share growth.
  • Lead the development and execution of local brand and marketing plans aligned with company objectives.
  • Deliver impactful marketing campaigns from concept to execution, ensuring measurable business results.
  • Collaborate closely with media agencies and internal stakeholders to maximize brand visibility across all relevant channels, with a strong focus on digital.
  • Monitor campaign effectiveness and optimize activities based on agreed KPIs and market insights.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, consumer behaviour and competitive dynamics to identify growth opportunities.
  • Work cross-functionally with global and local teams, including Marketing, Digital, Regulatory, Supply Chain and other operational functions.
  • Contribute to annual and long-term business planning while sharing best practices to support global brand development.

SKILLS

  • Strategic mindset with a strong commercial vision.
  • Excellent leadership, decision-making and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to inspire and engage others.
  • Highly analytical, results-driven and customer-focused.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including P&L management experience.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive and hands-on approach.
  • Ability to work independently while successfully leading cross-functional collaboration.
  • Adaptable, resilient and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

EXPERIENCE

  • Significant experience in brand marketing and/or commercial leadership roles within the Consumer Healthcare and/or FMCG industry.
  • Proven track record of delivering profitable growth, building brands and managing commercial performance.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing cross-functional teams, external partners and multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong P&L management experience with the ability to translate strategy into measurable business results.

This job description is a summary of the typical functions of the job; not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible responsibilities, tasks and duties. Norgine reserves the right to change responsibilities to meet business and organisational needs as necessary. 

Benefits

Why Join Norgine?

Why Join Us? 

At Norgine, you’ll be part of an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives. 

Bring your curiosity, creativity, and drive — however you work best, you will find the support to succeed. 

Ways of Thinking & Working to Support Your Growth 

  • Curious, reflective, and open to different perspectives 
  • Collaborative across teams, functions, and geographies 
  • Comfortable working independently and asking questions when needed 

  

Apply via LinkedIn or through our careers page. 

This job advert summarises key responsibilities and is not exhaustive. Norgine may adjust responsibilities as needed. 

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all backgrounds. 

Our benefits may vary per location. Please liaise with the Norgine TA representative to obtain more information.  

If you want a multi-dimensional 3D career in a leading healthcare organisation, join us.

Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor &amp; Gamble.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What’s the role? </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Job </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Title: </span></span></strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">CX Apprentice - Data&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Reports to:&nbsp;</span></span></strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">CX Analytics and Performance Director&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Apprenticeship: </span></span></strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Data Analyst Level 4&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Duration:&nbsp;</span></span></strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">12-18 months, subject to learner progress + End Point Assessment&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></span></p> <h2><strong>Role Purpose</strong></h2> <p>To support the Customer Service department in turning core operational data into clear, actionable insight — covering everything from divisional headcount and budgets through to CS performance metrics, carrier claims and returns — helping the business understand performance and identify where the customer experience can be improved.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Support core CS operational performance reporting across the department, including divisional headcount, budgets and key performance metrics such as CSAT and APH.</li> <li>Collect, clean and validate data from multiple internal and external sources across CX/CS operations, including carrier claims, returns (e.g. ZigZag), post-dispatch communications and customer contact systems.</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards and reports (e.g. Power BI) tracking department-wide CS metrics, from workforce and budget data to claims and returns performance.</li> <li>Write and run SQL queries to extract and manipulate data from relational databases in support of departmental reporting.</li> <li>Identify trends and patterns across headcount, budget, claims, returns and delivery data, flagging root causes and opportunities for improvement.</li> <li>Support CS leadership and wider teams with ad hoc analysis to inform decision-making, resourcing and client reporting.</li> <li>Maintain data quality standards across CS operational data sets, escalating and helping resolve data quality issues as they arise.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We Need From You</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A genuine interest in data and how it drives business and operational decisions</li> <li>Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail</li> <li>Willingness to learn SQL, Power BI and other data tools</li> <li>Comfortable working with numbers and translating data into insight for non-technical audiences</li> <li>GCSEs (or equivalent) at Grade 4 or above in English and Maths, or working towards Functional Skills Level 2</li> <li>Proactively manage your own learning, working closely with your training provider to meet course deadlines and complete tasks on time</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You'll Get In Return</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A fully funded Data Analyst (Level 4) apprenticeship qualification</li> <li>A competitive apprentice salary</li> <li>20% of your working week protected for off-the-job (OTJ) training, on top of your day-to-day role</li> <li>Learning directly from industry experts and professionals throughout your apprenticeship</li> <li>Free lunches on site</li> <li>GP access &amp; Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)</li> <li>Additional wellbeing support, including on-site physio and dentist</li> <li>Staff discounts on global brands across beauty and wellness</li> <li>The opportunity to build a long-term career with us beyond your apprenticeship</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse &amp; inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG Ingenuity please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description: <div> <p><strong>Senior Customer Success Manager (Enterprise)</strong></p> <p>Location: London | Department: Revenue| Employment type: Full Time</p> <br> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to join us here at GWI. Not just any Senior Customer Success Manager though. Someone ambitious and genuine, who works best in the midst of a collaborative and forward-thinking team. That’s because as a GWIer you’ll be immersed in the fast-moving world of data tech. We think big to make an impact,, we’re not afraid to <strong>ask why</strong> and we always <strong>show respect</strong>. Those values are what got us where we are today, and they’re a big part of what we’re looking for in you.</p> <br> <h1><strong>About the job</strong></h1> <p>The Enterprise Customer Success team at GWI is responsible for helping clients to achieve their desired outcomes through the adoption and practical application of our product and data sets. This is achieved through proactive relationship building, education, and consultative support.</p> <br> <h1><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h1> <p>Working within our Enterprise Customer Success team, you will be part of a global account team assuming ownership and management of the relationship of some of our largest clients, helping them to realise value and support growth.</p> <br> <ul> <li>Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and end users&nbsp;</li> <li>Consult clients on how to solve challenges &amp; achieve desired outcomes with GWI</li> <li>Create success plans to document and track the achievement of desired outcomes</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Identify and support growth opportunities with your AM counterparts</li> <li>Pull, interpret, and deliver regular usage reports for each of your accounts.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Collaborate with the global team to develop and execute strategies for lapsed user engagement, creation of onboarding collateral and project support</li> <li>Accurately forecast risk with account manager and develop a plan to mitigate</li> <li>Working closely with other internal teams to help deliver custom projects and strategic workshops</li> <li>Be the voice of the customer and channel feedback to relevant departments.</li> </ul> <br> <h1><strong>About you</strong></h1> <p>First things first, as a disruptor in the global market research industry, we haven’t come this far without entrepreneurial spirit and a get-up-and-go attitude. So if you think we’ll see that in you, then you’re already halfway there. Here’s the rest of what we’d like you to bring to the table.</p> <br> <h2><strong>Essential</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in a Customer Success, or Account Management role</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills and experience building strong internal and external relationships</li> <li>Strong Analytical skills with a high attention to detail.</li> <li>Proactive, curious-minded, and organized team player with innovative ideas to inspire customer engagement, loyalty, and adoption</li> <li>Ability to bring data to life with stories and present with confidence.</li> <li>Passion for building trust and communicating effectively with customers</li> <li>Ability to work autonomously and look for improvements in ways or working and processes</li> <li>Natural ability to switch between different roles and wear different hats.&nbsp;</li> <li>Highly organized and able to juggle multiple tasks with competing deadlines</li> <li>Customer focused mindset, with a natural ability to relate to clients and understand their issues - while delivering a high level of customer service.</li> </ul> <br> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience working in a Customer Success or Support team</li> <li>Experience working at a SaaS business or with market research/audience profiling data</li> <li>Experience using tools such as Intercom, Salesforce, Mixpanel, SalesLoft, Zendesk, etc.&nbsp;</li> </ul> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>What We Offer 🧘</h1> <p>At GWI, you’ll find meaningful work, visible impact, and a culture that empowers you to do your best. Our package includes:</p> <ul> <li>Time to recharge – 25 days’ annual leave, plus office closures over the holidays.</li> <li>Health &amp; wellbeing – Health cash plan, enhanced family benefits, carer days, and mental health support.</li> <li>Financial benefits – Competitive salary, 4% pension matching, and recognition programs that celebrate success.</li> <li>Flexibility &amp; balance – Flexitime, early Friday finishes, hybrid and remote options, plus a “work from home” budget.</li> <li>Career growth – Accredited learning, leadership development, and global career mobility.</li> <li>Community &amp; impact – DE&amp;I initiatives, volunteering opportunities, donation matching, and payroll giving.</li> </ul> <p>Put all that together and GWI is the friendliest, most fulfilling place any of us has ever worked.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>Diversity, Equity &amp; Inclusion 🫶</h1> <p>Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.</p> <p>As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.</p> <p>We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.</p> <p>At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/2g0akAyAlUU?si=dIgYyrKaAlNZK-NQ" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>#li-hybrid<br>#LI-</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Director – Field Service / Facilities Management
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>The Joblogic Story</strong></h3> <p>Established in 1998,&nbsp;<strong>Joblogic</strong> is the UK’s #1 <strong>Field Service Management</strong> (FSM) software platform. We are a global business with offices in the <strong>UK</strong>, <strong>Pakistan</strong>, and <strong>Vietnam</strong>. Since our management buy-out in 2013, we have grown from <strong>~£500K </strong>ARR to <strong>~£35M+ </strong>ARR and expanded our team from 11 to 500+ people.</p> <p>Recently, we secured a strategic growth investment from <strong>Vista Equity Partners </strong>— a global technology investor specialising in enterprise software. This investment includes over <strong>£100</strong> million in new primary capital and will fuel our next phase of growth by accelerating our <strong>AI-first roadmap</strong>, expanding our platform into CAFM (Computer-Aided Facilities Management) capabilities, and supporting our expansion across Europe and beyond.</p> <p>With <strong>Vista’s </strong>backing, we’re transforming from a successful UK business into a global scaling SaaS rocket ship, and we’d love for you to join us on our journey to <strong>£100M </strong>ARR across international markets.</p> <p><strong>Joblogic </strong>provides software to service contractors who install and maintain the built environment. Our platform helps businesses streamline operations, improve profitability, ensure compliance, and achieve rapid growth. With over <strong>100,000</strong> users across industries including HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management, and building fabric maintenance, we are entering a new era of intelligent automation, predictive maintenance, and data-driven decision-making for service firms.</p></div><p>We're hiring a&nbsp;<strong>Product Director </strong>to lead the strategy, vision, and execution of Joblogic's product portfolio across Field Service and Facilities Management. This is a senior leadership role for someone with <strong>broad product expertise, deep domain understanding, strong people leadership and mentoring skills, and a proven ability to design, build, and scale AI-powered products</strong> in B2B SaaS.</p> <p>You'll own the product vision and roadmap across our entire FSM and CAFM platform, lead, grow, and mentor a high-performing product team, and partner with the executive team to translate market opportunity into commercial outcomes. You'll also be the driving force behind our AI-first product agenda — defining where AI delivers genuine value, embedding intelligence into core workflows, and ensuring we ship responsibly and at pace.</p> <p>Above all, this is a people leadership role. You'll be the coach, mentor, and standard-setter for the product team — building careers, raising the craft bar, and creating the kind of environment where ambitious product people do their best work. You'll be equal parts strategist, people leader, and product craftsperson.</p> <h3>What You'll Own</h3> <p>You'll lead product across the Joblogic platform, including:</p> <ul> <li>End-to-end FSM and CAFM platform strategy</li> <li>AI-first product initiatives — copilots, agents, predictive maintenance, intelligent scheduling, document intelligence</li> <li>Reactive, PPM, and contract workflows</li> <li>Scheduling, dispatch, and optimisation</li> <li>Field engineer mobile experience</li> <li>Asset lifecycle management</li> <li>Quoting → job → invoicing flows</li> <li>Customer portals and self-service</li> <li>Data, reporting, analytics, and embedded BI</li> <li>Vertical-specific FM workflows (HVAC, M&amp;E, FM, building maintenance)</li> <li>Platform, integrations, and developer experience</li> </ul> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <h3>1. Set Product Vision &amp; Strategy</h3> <ul> <li>Define and communicate a compelling 1–3 year product vision aligned to Joblogic's £100M ARR ambition.</li> <li>Translate market trends, customer insight, and competitive dynamics into a clear, prioritised portfolio roadmap.</li> <li>Make sharp build / buy / partner / sunset decisions across the platform.</li> <li>Partner with the CEO, CPO, CTO, CRO, and CCO to align product strategy with commercial and GTM strategy.</li> </ul> <h3>2. Lead the AI-First Product Agenda</h3> <ul> <li>Own Joblogic's AI product strategy across LLMs, ML, agents, and predictive analytics.</li> <li>Identify the highest-value AI use cases across FSM and CAFM workflows — from intelligent scheduling and dynamic dispatch to predictive maintenance, automated quoting, and engineer copilots.</li> <li>Set principles for responsible, safe, and explainable AI — including data, privacy, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop design.</li> <li>Stay close to the rapidly evolving AI landscape (foundation models, agentic patterns, RAG, fine-tuning, evals) and translate it into pragmatic product bets.</li> <li>Partner with engineering and data leadership to shape the AI platform, data architecture, and ML lifecycle.</li> </ul> <h3>3. Mentor, Coach &amp; Lead a High-Performing Product Team</h3> <ul> <li>Hire, mentor, and develop Product Managers, Senior PMs, and Group PMs across the portfolio — making people growth a core part of how you spend your week.</li> <li>Run regular 1:1s, career conversations, and development plans tailored to each PM's strengths, goals, and growth areas.</li> <li>Coach PMs through complex trade-offs, stakeholder management, difficult prioritisation calls, and high-stakes customer situations.</li> <li>Set the standard for discovery, product craft, written communication, and commercial thinking — and actively raise the bar through feedback and pairing.</li> <li>Establish clear team structure, ownership, levelling, and career paths as the function scales.</li> <li>Build a strong performance culture: clear expectations, candid feedback, recognition, and the courage to make hard people decisions when needed.</li> <li>Foster a psychologically safe, inclusive environment where customer obsession, evidence-led decisions, and outcome ownership thrive.</li> <li>Invest in the team's craft — running PRD reviews, discovery clinics, AI literacy sessions, and post-mortems.</li> </ul> <h3>4. title: Senior Data Scientist
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our award-winning Data Science team at a pivotal moment. Carwow operates a two-sided marketplace — connecting car buyers and sellers at scale — and data science sits at the heart of how we make that marketplace smarter, faster, and more valuable for everyone in it. In fact, we recently won GenAI initiative of the Year at the British Data Awards. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role working centrally across the business. You'll partner with teams spanning Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations — developing and deploying ML and AI solutions that drive outcomes across both sides of our marketplace. The problems you'll work on are genuinely varied: pricing models, propensity and demand signals that sharpen marketing spend, personalised recommendations for our web product and CRM, and LLM-powered solutions for operational challenges like document verification. You'll translate ambiguous business problems into structured, production-ready solutions — and you'll be expected to deliver them end-to-end, from first principles through to being deployment-ready and beyond. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING End-to-End ML & AI Delivery: Lead data science initiatives from problem framing through to deployment, monitoring, and iteration — delivering the full production lifecycle. With no dedicated ML engineering function, you'll be responsible for ensuring your solutions are robust, scalable, and performing in the real world long after they ship. GenAI & LLM Application: Design and build LLM-powered solutions where they create genuine business value — document processing, intelligent search, content understanding, and beyond. Apply them alongside classical ML with clear judgement about where each approach earns its place. Commercial Impact: Connect your work directly to business outcomes. Whether you're building a model to improve marketing efficiency, a pricing signal to sharpen commercial decisions, or a recommendation engine to increase conversion — you understand the business lever you're pulling and design your solutions accordingly. Prototyping & Experimentation: Move fast to test ideas before committing to full-scale development. Define rigorous success metrics upfront, validate honestly, and know when to double down and when to walk away. OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our award-winning Data Science team at a pivotal moment. Carwow operates a two-sided marketplace — connecting car buyers and sellers at scale — and data science sits at the heart of how we make that marketplace smarter, faster, and more valuable for everyone in it. In fact, we recently won GenAI initiative of the Year at the British Data Awards.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role working centrally across the business. You'll partner with teams spanning Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations — developing and deploying ML and AI solutions that drive outcomes across both sides of our marketplace. The problems you'll work on are genuinely varied: pricing models, propensity and demand signals that sharpen marketing spend, personalised recommendations for our web product and CRM, and LLM-powered solutions for operational challenges like document verification.

You'll translate ambiguous business problems into structured, production-ready solutions — and you'll be expected to deliver them end-to-end, from first principles through to being deployment-ready and beyond.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • End-to-End ML & AI Delivery: Lead data science initiatives from problem framing through to deployment, monitoring, and iteration — delivering the full production lifecycle.   • GenAI & LLM Application: Design and build LLM-powered solutions where they create genuine business value — document processing, intelligent search, content understanding, and beyond. Apply them alongside classical ML with clear judgement about where each approach earns its place.

Whether you're building a model to improve marketing efficiency, a pricing signal to sharpen commercial decisions, or a recommendation engine to increase conversion — you understand the business lever you're pulling and design your solutions accordingly.

raw.description:
Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

Location: Manchester

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

Package: £80k OTE 

As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

Key Objectives 

Core Accountability 

  • Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
  • Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
  • Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
  • Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
  • Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 

Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

  • Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
  • Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
  • Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
  • Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

  • Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
  • Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
  • Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
  • Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

  • Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
  • Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
  • Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
  • Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

  • Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
  • Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
  • Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
  • Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
  • Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
  • Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
  • Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

 

About PHMG:

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a Manchester-founded creative business into the world's leading audio branding agency. Today, we partner with almost 40,000 clients across more than 50 countries, including global brands such as Coca-Cola, Samsung, Adidas and Audi, alongside ambitious SMEs in virtually every sector. Innovation fuels everything we do. From day one, we set out to redefine audio branding by harmonising creativity, technology and measurable results. That mindset continues to shape our evolution as we expand beyond sound into a broader suite of client communication services. In 2025, PHMG entered a defining new chapter as an employee-owned business. Ownership now sits with the people who power our creativity, performance and growth. It strengthens our independence, sharpens our long-term focus and ensures success is shared. We are proud recipients of the King's Award for Enterprise, recognised for innovation, growth and performance excellence. Today, more than 800 colleagues across six global offices collaborate to deliver work that blends artistry with commercial impact. Joining PHMG means becoming part of a people-powered, future-focused company that values creativity, champions diversity and invests in professional growth. Sound good?
