title: VP Finance
description: The Role We are seeking a VP Finance to build the finance function that will support Geordie through its next stage of growth. Your mission is to build the financial foundation that enables Geordie to scale with confidence. You'll combine rigorous financial management, thoughtful planning and modern systems to give the business the insight, discipline and operational excellence it needs to grow. Initially, you will be a hands-on individual contributor responsible for building and operating the finance function. You'll own financial planning, reporting, forecasting, cash management and financial operations, while working closely with our external finance partners who manage bookkeeping, VAT and other compliance processes. This is not a traditional finance role focused solely on reporting historical numbers. We are looking for someone who enjoys building systems, improving processes and helping leadership make better decisions through high-quality financial analysis and insight. Over time, you'll build an exceptionally efficient finance function that leverages automation and AI wherever practical, allowing the team to scale alongside the business without growing linearly with headcount. What You'll Do Financial Leadership Own the finance function end-to-end, initially as Geordie's sole internal finance hire. Build robust financial planning, budgeting and forecasting processes that support rapid company growth. Own the company operating model, including revenue, ARR, hiring plans, cash runway and scenario modelling. Produce clear, high-quality reporting for leadership, the Board and investors. Partner closely with the CEO and leadership team to provide financial analysis that supports strategic decision-making. Financial Operations Own cash flow management, treasury oversight and working capital. Oversee invoicing, accounts payable and financial operations, working closely with external finance partners. Build scalable quote-to-cash processes alongside RevOps and Legal, ensuring strong financial controls as the business grows. Ensure banking, insurance and core financial infrastructure operate effectively. Own financial compliance across our UK and US entities, including tax requirements, R&D claims and coordination with external advisers. Business Performance Develop a deep understanding of the company's unit economics, gross margins and customer profitability. Help leadership understand where capital is being deployed most effectively and provide financial insight to support investment decisions. Support commercial teams with financial analysis around customer profitability, pricing, commercial structures and larger customer opportunities. Partner with Product as a finance domain expert, providing input into the evolution of Geordie's cost management capabilities. Finance Systems & Automation Help build a modern, highly efficient finance function through thoughtful use of AI, automation and best-in-class financial systems. Work closely with our Internal Systems & AI Lead to identify opportunities to automate finance workflows, improve reporting and reduce manual effort. Continuously improve finance systems, processes and controls to increase the leverage of the finance function as the company scales. Fundraising & Growth Support future fundraising processes through financial modelling, investor reporting and due diligence. Help ensure the business maintains the financial discipline and operational maturity required to scale. Over time, build and lead a lean, high-performing finance team as the complexity of the business grows. Ideal Background Experience leading finance within a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology company. Strong background in FP&A, strategic finance or commercial finance, with the ability to build robust financial models and planning processes. Comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor while building functions from first principles. Experience producing Board and investor reporting and supporting fundraising or due diligence processes. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insight. Experience improving finance systems, processes and operational workflows. Curious about AI and excited by the opportunity to build a modern, highly automated finance function. Highly proactive, organised and comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment. Why This Role Finance has an opportunity to change dramatically over the coming decade. We believe AI and automation will fundamentally change how finance teams operate, allowing small teams to deliver far greater leverage than ever before. At Geordie, we want to build a finance function that embraces that opportunity from day one. Rather than scaling through headcount alone, we want to scale through better systems, better automation and better decision-making. This role offers the opportunity to build that function from the ground up and, over time, grow it into a world-class finance organisation while helping shape the future of one of the fastest-growing AI security companies. Our Values Solve What Matters We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. Build, Learn, Iterate We favour momentum over perfection; testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together. Kind, Not Comfortable We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible. title: Claims Handler – Gadget & Warranty
description: Turning risk into opportunity Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to. We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back. We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo. What we are looking for We are looking for a confident, analytical and detail-focused QA & Authorisation Handler to join our Technical Claims Support Team. You will provide a key technical control across our claims operation, completing Quality Assurance reviews and reviewing claim settlements at the authorisation stage . As the final line of defence before a claim settlement is approved , you will be responsible for independently reviewing the claim, evidence, policy coverage and settlement calculation before making the decision to authorise, pass back or escalate . This requires confidence and strong technical judgement. You must be comfortable making decisions, challenging claim assessments where something does not look right and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your decision. The role goes beyond identifying individual errors. You will use findings from QA and authorisations to identify potential financial leakage, recurring handling issues, process and control gaps and emerging trends across the claims operation. You will be comfortable using data to understand where issues are occurring, identify root causes and turn findings into practical improvements to processes, controls, guidance and training. As ClaimSorted works across a range of insurance products and partners, you will need to be adaptable and confident moving between different products, policy wordings, processes and priorities while maintaining consistently high standards. As part of the wider Technical Claims Support Team, you will also support other technical claims activities where required. Responsibilities Review claim settlements at authorisation stage across all ClaimSorted products , acting as the final line of defence before payment is approved. Independently review policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations, making confident decisions to authorise, pass back or escalate . Complete Quality Assurance reviews across all products , ensuring claims are handled accurately, fairly and in line with policy, partner and internal requirements. Identify and prevent financial leakage , incorrect settlements and other customer or financial risks. Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to Claims Handlers, confidently challenging decisions where required. raw.title: Claims Handler – Gadget & Warranty
raw.description:
Turning risk into opportunity

Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to.

We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back.

We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo.


What we are looking for

We are looking for a confident, analytical and detail-focused QA & Authorisation Handler to join our Technical Claims Support Team.

You will provide a key technical control across our claims operation, completing Quality Assurance reviews and reviewing claim settlements at the authorisation stage.

As the final line of defence before a claim settlement is approved, you will be responsible for independently reviewing the claim, evidence, policy coverage and settlement calculation before making the decision to authorise, pass back or escalate.

This requires confidence and strong technical judgement. You must be comfortable making decisions, challenging claim assessments where something does not look right and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your decision.

The role goes beyond identifying individual errors. You will use findings from QA and authorisations to identify potential financial leakage, recurring handling issues, process and control gaps and emerging trends across the claims operation.

You will be comfortable using data to understand where issues are occurring, identify root causes and turn findings into practical improvements to processes, controls, guidance and training.

As ClaimSorted works across a range of insurance products and partners, you will need to be adaptable and confident moving between different products, policy wordings, processes and priorities while maintaining consistently high standards.

As part of the wider Technical Claims Support Team, you will also support other technical claims activities where required.

Responsibilities

  • Review claim settlements at authorisation stage across all ClaimSorted products, acting as the final line of defence before payment is approved.

  • Independently review policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations, making confident decisions to authorise, pass back or escalate.

  • Complete Quality Assurance reviews across all products, ensuring claims are handled accurately, fairly and in line with policy, partner and internal requirements.

  • Identify and prevent financial leakage, incorrect settlements and other customer or financial risks.

  • Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to Claims Handlers, confidently challenging decisions where required.

  • Use QA, authorisation and leakage data across products to identify trends, recurring errors, training needs and process or control gaps.

  • Support improvements to claims processes, guidance and controls based on findings and root-cause analysis.

  • Maintain accurate records of decisions and findings while effectively managing and prioritising QA and authorisation workloads.

  • Build and maintain the technical knowledge required to work confidently across all ClaimSorted product lines, partners and processes.

  • Work collaboratively across Claims Operations and the wider Technical Claims Support Team.

Skills and Experience Required

  • +2 years experience completing claim authorisations within an insurance claims team is essential, with responsibility for reviewing and making decisions on claim settlements.

  • +3 years experience working across two or more of the following product lines within a claims role: Pet, Travel, Property, Auto, Gadget or similar insurance products.

  • Strong technical claims knowledge, with the confidence to independently review, challenge and make evidence-based decisions.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations.

  • Strong analytical skills, with experience identifying financial leakage, trends, recurring errors and process or control gaps.

  • Able to confidently provide clear, constructive feedback and explain the rationale behind decisions.

  • Highly organised and able to prioritise a varied workload based on risk, value and urgency.

  • Adaptable and comfortable learning new products, policy wordings and processes in a fast-paced environment.

Mission

To act as a final line of defence within the claims settlement process, ensuring claim outcomes are accurate, fair and supported by policy and evidence before settlement is authorised.

The QA & Authorisation Handler will use strong technical judgement and independent decision-making to protect customer outcomes and financial performance, identifying errors, potential leakage and operational risks before they result in incorrect settlements.

Through Quality Assurance, data analysis and trend identification, the role will also identify wider knowledge, process and control gaps and help turn individual findings into sustainable improvements across Claims Operations

We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

🚀 The Adventure Ahead

As our Workplace Experience Manager in Paris, you will be the heartbeat of our office, transforming ordinary workdays into vibrant, hospitality-driven experiences. You’ll take full ownership of building a thriving local community, executing memorable events, and ensuring our facilities run like a well-oiled machine. By adapting global initiatives to fit our unique Parisian flair, you’ll directly shape our culture and create an energizing environment where top talent loves to gather, collaborate, and thrive.

🛠️ The Day-to-Day

  • Lead the Experience: Elevate daily office operations and spearhead a warm, polished, hospitality-driven environment for all employees, visitors, candidates, and customers.

  • Curate the Culture: Own the local engagement calendar from concept to execution, crafting memorable themed events, social activities, cultural celebrations, and wellness initiatives.

  • Master the Operations: Manage facilities, vendor relationships, repairs, supplies, cleaning, food and beverage, security, access, and floor plan management seamlessly.

  • Build Strong Alliances: Cultivate meaningful relationships with local employees, leadership, landlords, building management, and cross-functional global partners.

  • Drive Strategic Growth: Oversee the workplace budget, purchase orders, and spending forecasting while supporting office projects, space planning, tech rollouts, and branding installations.

  • Listen and Evolve: Gather employee feedback continuously to identify high-impact opportunities and adapt global workplace programs to reflect the true spirit of Paris.

⚡ Your Superpowers

  • Proven Track Record: Brings 5+ years of experience successfully managing workplace operations, facilities, hospitality, or employee experience independently.

  • Event Mastery: Possesses hands-on expertise in conceptualizing, budgeting, and hosting high-quality, creative, and engaging community events.

  • Operational Excellence: Demonstrates strong skills in vendor management, budget forecasting, space planning, and facilities logistics.

  • Bilingual Communication: Speaks and writes with professional fluency in both French and English to effortlessly bridge global and local teams.

  • Proactive Problem-Solver: Takes complete ownership with energy, adaptability, excellent organization, and a true passion for bringing people together.

🎯 Bonus Points

  • Fast-Paced Savvy: Prior experience working within a global tech or fast-moving organization.

  • Design & Space Vision: An eye for office branding, space layout optimization, and workplace aesthetics.

Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

  • Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

  • Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

Our Promise to You 😍

  • Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

  • Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

  • Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!

  • Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

About Sidetrade:

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

Requirements

Today, we're looking for our Global VP of Talent Acquisition to build and lead our Ai-native shift and create the dream team for our next stage of growth. This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership challenge for designing a scalable, data-driven talent acquisition function across all regions in the world (North America, Europe, and APAC), all functions and levels -from AI expert to GTM and from Mid-level to Executives. You'll partner directly with the executive team and hiring managers to ensure we attract, hire, and onboard the talent needed to hit our growth targets, while building a TA function that's efficient, candidate-centric, and built for scale.

Because it’s instrumental to the strategy, this role will report directly to the CEO.

What you would do:

  • Strategy & Leadership: Define and own the global talent acquisition strategy, aligning hiring plans with headcount budgets, business goals, and workforce planning across all regions.
  • Team Management: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global TA team, including regional leads, recruiters, sourcers, and coordinators; set goals, coach performance, and grow internal talent.
  • Executive & Leadership Hiring: Personally in charge of hiring senior C-level roles with the CEO.
  • Process & Scale: Design and continuously improve AI Agents for recruiting processes, workflows, and SLAs to ensure a consistent, efficient, and high-quality hiring experience.
  • Employer Brand: Own the company's employer brand and candidate value proposition globally; partner with Marketing and Comms to strengthen our reputation as an employer of choice.
  • Data & Metrics: Establish TA metrics and dashboards (time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, quality-of-hire, pipeline conversion, diversity metrics) and use data to drive decisions and report to the executive team and board.
  • Systems & Tools: Own the ATS and recruiting tech stack; evaluate and implement tools (sourcing, assessment, AI-enabled recruiting tools, CRM) to improve efficiency and candidate experience.
  • DEI: Champion diverse and inclusive hiring practices globally, ensuring equitable processes across all regions.
  • Global & Compliance: Ensure hiring practices comply with local labor laws and regulations across all operating countries; manage relationships with external agencies, RPOs, and immigration/visa partners as needed.
  • Budget Ownership: Own the TA budget, including headcount, tooling, agency spend, and employer branding investments.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Act as a strategic advisor to hiring managers and executives on org design, market talent trends, compensation benchmarking, and hiring strategy.

 What we are looking for:

  • 10+ years in talent acquisition, with 5+ years in a senior TA leadership role (VP, Head of TA, or similar) at a SaaS or high-growth AI company.
  • Proven experience building and scaling global TA functions across multiple countries/regions (US, Europe)
  • Track record of personally hiring C-Levels
  • Experience operating in a mid-size, fast-growing company environment
  • Hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves approach balanced with strategic, big-picture thinking.
  • Experience managing distributed, cross-cultural teams.
  • Natural ability to convince and motivate C-Level candidates to join our AI strategy.
  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable building and presenting TA metrics and forecasts to executive leadership and the board.
  • Deep knowledge of modern sourcing strategies, employer branding, and recruiting technology (AI Recruiter Agents, ATS, CRM).
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence and partner with senior executives.
  • Strong understanding of global employment law and compliance considerations related to hiring.

Because when you thrive, we all succeed! 

We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know. 

Agencies 

We only accept applications from invited agencies via our Workable portal. Unsolicited CVs sent to managers or HR won’t be subject to fees.

Joining our Live Games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games, while also embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over 7 billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating over $20 million per year, we are the world’s largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will join the Live Studios team. Our main mission is to transform hypercasual titles into deep, engaging midcore games by developing richer gameplay experiences, stronger progression systems, and long-term player engagement.

The studio is currently working on titles including Epic Plane Evolution, Path of Kings, Gear Fight and Archery Clash.

Role

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Modify and iterate on Unity projects across our portfolio of hybrid-casual and midcore games

  • Create custom gameplay setups, scenes, animations, environments, skins, and visual assets

  • Prototype gameplay variations and concepts for advertising

  • Record, edit, and upload gameplay videos for creative testing

  • Share modified builds with the Marketing and User Acquisition teams

  • Analyze creative performance and benchmark competitors to improve results

Profile

  • Strong Unity skills and experience modifying existing game projects

  • Interest in mobile games, particularly hybrid-casual, casual, or midcore titles

  • Creative, curious, and comfortable experimenting independently

  • Basic knowledge in motion tools such as DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut Desktop

  • Able to work across multiple projects and adapt quickly

  • Fluent in spoken and written English or Russian

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills. Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use)

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

raw.title: Union Relations Lead / Directeur(rice) du Paritarisme
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The mission of the Union Relations Lead

Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions.


⭐ What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions).

  • You'll operate at the highest levels of the paritariste ecosystem: CFDT and FO confederal leadership, sector federations, IP boards, organisations patronales.

  • You'll shape the strategy, not just execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability (the playbook is yours to define)

  • You'll work directly with Founders, Public Affair as well as Public Sector and Enterprise leadership.

  • Real ownership from day one, in one of the fastest-growing tech unicorns in Europe.

⭐️ Your role

Relationships & Presence

  • Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the organizations that represent employees and members across the sectors that matter to Alan (unions, federations, and the structures that convene them).

  • Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design the engagement strategy at confederal, federal and branch level.

  • Represent Alan in federations, working groups, congrès and paritariste institutions where our sector’s future is discussed.

  • Be the credible consistent Alan voice social partners recognise

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Public Sector work

  • Be a partner to our teams serving large private employers and public sector clients, briefing them on the social partners context and how Alan’s offer speaks to their priorities

  • Introduce the right contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, turning Alan’s ecosystem relationships into concrete commercial leverage.

  • Share Alan’s content with social partners to help them assess Alan on its merits and form their own view.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation

  • Follow the dialogue at branch level and across the paritariste ecosystem and turn that understanding into internal clarity.

  • Represent Alan in the federations and working groups where our sector's future is discussed, contributing a constructive and recognizable voice.

  • Be a sharp, early internal voice on where social dialogue is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy.

Build & Scale

  • Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on social partner positions, branch agreements, and paritariste institutions shared with Enterprise and Public Sector deal teams to increase win rates.

  • Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our social partner engagement and documentation.

  • Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Public Sector team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

  • Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how social partners and competitors position themselves in our key markets.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Union Relations Lead role at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of total experience in social partner relations: in a union organization, a branch federation, a paritariste institution, or in an external affairs role at a mutelle, IP or insurer

  • Have legitimate credibility at federation level: ability to engage federation leadership as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive engagement at federation level on employer side.

  • Have deep knowledge of the paritariste ecosystem: branch agreements, confederal mandates, protection sociale reforms, and how institutions at each level function

  • Have proven ability to build trust with social partners from the employer/state side

  • Have outstanding stakeholder management: calm, long-game, trustworthy, discreet, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself.

  • Have ability to translate Alan’s product and strategy into compelling narratives for social partner audiences

  • Demonstrable impact from prior social-partner work on an organization’s commercial and strategic outcomes

  • Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris.

Nice to have:

  • A confederal or federal elected / permanent past.

  • Experience inside a paritariste institution

  • Experience inside a sector federation on its social dialogue agenda.

  • Legal background in droit social and comfort reading accords collectifs quickly.

  • International exposure to the European social dialogue ecosystem.

  • Prior experience with RFPs or tenders involving union-negotiated or paritariste schemes.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

title: People Operations Specialist
description: About Vibe Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. About the Role You'll join People Ops, the Systems and Operations pillar of the People team. It owns payroll, HRIS, onboarding and offboarding, contracts, benefits, and compliance across France, the US, and our remote geographies. You'll report to Melissa, our Senior Global HR Systems and Operations Manager in Paris. We're opening this role because Vibe is scaling fast across regions, and payroll plus People Ops now need a dedicated owner who keeps the engine running and makes it better. If you want real ownership of payroll from day one, a front-row seat to how an international team actually operates across three geographies, and the room to reshape and automate the work as you go, this is the seat. What You'll Do Payroll and contractors Run the monthly French payroll cycle with our external provider, from variable inputs to final validation. Check every payslip before sign-off to catch errors before they reach employees. Keep EOR payroll on schedule across our remote geographies. Own contractor operations end to end, from timesheet collection to the Finance provisioning file. Reconcile each cycle to catch what doesn't add up before it’s live. People operations and HR admin Manage employment documents for a team spread across France, the US, and remote. Administer benefits: enrollments, changes, and the questions employees bring. Run onboarding and offboarding logistics so every joiner and leaver lands cleanly. Employee support Serve as first point of contact for employees on People questions. Triage incoming requests through our ticketing system against agreed SLAs. Research individual employee cases across policy, contracts, and local labour law. Systems and projects Maintain HRIS data hygiene and the workflows behind it. Drive People Ops projects end to end, with clear scope, deadlines, and stakeholders. What You Need 3+ years in payroll, HR administration, or People Ops. An apprenticeship or internship counts. Strong knowledge of French payroll and labour law fundamentals: contracts, absences, final pay, health and provident cover. Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and real comfort working with numbers. Project management basics: you've run something with a real deadline and a scope that moved. Experience with an HRIS. Fluent French and English. English is our working language. Nice to Haves Hands-on experience in a ticketing tool. Exposure to international or EOR payroll. Comfort building automations to cut manual work. Experience at a scale-up. Our Values At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. What We Offer For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €45k–€65k , plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates. At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up: Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it. Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals. Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week! Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan. Meal vouchers — Via Swile. Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide. Our Interview Process We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours. Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly. Take-home assignment + live debrief — A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar. Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit. Equal Opportunity Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. Referral Instructions Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.
Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.
Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.
This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the role

The Performance team owns advertiser outcomes at Vibe: the prediction models, the bidding engine, pacing, and the delivery stack underneath them. You'd report to Clément Schiano, Engineering Manager for Performance.

We're hiring because our infrastructure work has become two jobs. One is building the platform and tooling that gets data scientists from experiment to production quickly. The other is keeping the production serving path fast, cheap and reliable as traffic grows. One person currently does both, and the reliability half loses whenever there's a modeling deadline. This role takes over that half.

Why it's interesting:

  • Scale is the problem we have. Vibe was acquired by Walmart and the plan is to run many more advertisers through the same bidding stack. How much of that we can take on depends directly on what the infrastructure can absorb.

  • Every bid is a real-time decision with advertiser budget behind it. If p99 moves the wrong way, advertisers under-deliver and we lose money that day. Cost works the same way: replica count and cloud bill are things you can move.

  • The team is seven people, so you'd have room to set direction on reliability. The stack already exists and works, so you're not starting from a blank page.

What You'll Do

  • Own reliability across the production stack: prediction serving, the bidding engine, pacing, delivery. Define the SLOs, build the observability to see them, and shape how we run on-call.

  • Bring p99 down on the serving path and run the bidding engine on fewer replicas without giving up latency.

  • Work on the data layer under real-time serving. Redis comes first: access patterns, caching strategy, behavior when it degrades.

  • Build a way to stress-test the platform end to end in staging so we find our ceiling before production does.

  • Handle capacity planning and infrastructure cost as advertiser volume grows.

  • Work closely with the data scientists shipping models into this stack, and with Benoît Delsart, who covers the platform and tooling side.

  • Run incident response and make sure postmortems turn into changes that ship.

  • Collaborate with other engineering teams, notably DSP, since our systems interact heavily with the rest of the stack.

What You Need

  • You've owned latency-sensitive services in production, on-call included. You've been paged for something serious and know how that goes.

  • Solid Kubernetes and cloud fundamentals. At ease debugging a p99 latency problem

  • Observability experience: metrics, tracing, logs, and opinions about what makes an alert worth waking someone for.

  • Infrastructure as code, CI/CD. You can ship the fix, not just find it.

  • You're comfortable owning systems you didn't design. You'll be on the hook for this stack before you understand every model in it.

Nice to Haves

  • High-QPS, low-latency serving experience: ad tech, trading, gaming, streaming or similar.

  • Debugging depth on Redis, Kafka or similar.

  • Capacity planning and cost work on a large footprint.

  • Experience with model rollouts and why they differ from service rollouts.

  • Background in programmatic, auctions or CTV.

  • Paris-based strongly preferred. We support relocation/visa sponsorship.

  • Experience with Go, Rust, Python

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

 

What We Offer

  • Variable pay — based on objectives you hit. No arbitrary targets.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

     

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  2. Manager interview — Meet Clément, the person you'd work with directly.

  3. Technical Debugging and Systems Design Interview — with Performance engineers

  4. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  5. Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

  6. Reference checks — Two calls, handled with discretion.

     

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

 

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

You'll get end-to-end ownership of systems the business can't run without, direct influence over the tools every data, ML, and analytics engineer at Vibe uses daily, and a mandate to treat performance and cost as core engineering problems, not afterthoughts.

What You'll Do

Platform & Services Ownership

  • Design and operate real-time event processing on Kafka at production scale

  • Build and run batch orchestration pipelines on Dagster

  • Own the serving path into ClickHouse Cloud from ingestion through query

  • Drive projects end-to-end from stakeholder requirements through post-launch iteration

  • Set architecture decisions on partitioning, materialization, retention, and compute sizing

Developer Enablement & Tooling

  • Build orchestration patterns and testing frameworks the whole team relies on

  • Establish CI/CD and data contracts that reduce manual review overhead

  • Turn recurring one-off fixes into reusable, documented building blocks

  • Design self-serve infrastructure that teams adopt without being told to

Reliability & Operational Excellence

  • Build alerting and dashboards that catch issues before users feel them

  • Set SLOs that reflect real business risk, not vanity metrics

  • Lead incident response during on-call rotations

  • Write runbooks and automation that shorten and reduce pages

  • Anticipate scaling limits before bid/win log growth turns them into incidents

Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Profile and optimize services across Kafka, Spark, DuckDB, and ClickHouse

  • Treat compute and storage spend as a first-class engineering metric

  • Lead cost reviews on the platform's most expensive systems

  • Instrument the platform to catch cost regressions early

Cross-Team Partnership

  • Translate ambiguous requests from data, ML, and product engineers into concrete deliverables

  • Push back on requests that aren't ready or aren't the right approach

  • Influence upstream teams on schema, semantics, and SLAs

  • Brief senior stakeholders on tradeoffs and decisions, not implementation detail

What You Need

  • 5+ years building and operating distributed, data-intensive systems in production

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or Rust, with real testing and code review discipline

  • Production experience with several of: Kafka, Spark, Iceberg or object storage, ClickHouse or similar column-store analytics

  • Experience owning services from code to production, including AWS, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code

  • A track record of measurably improving performance or cost on specific systems, and the ability to explain why

  • Strong cross-functional communication, including the judgment to push back on stakeholders with conflicting priorities

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in programmatic or streaming TV advertising

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en apprentissage statistique et IA générative pour rejoindre le département Image Données Signal (IDS) à Télécom Paris. Le sujet spécifique de ce post-doc porte sur la calibration des modèles génératifs pour des données. Dans la littérature, il existe très peu de résultats pratiques et théoriques concernant la capacité des modèles génératifs à fournir, au moment de l'inférence, une mesure d'incertitude sur certaines propriétés ciblées. C’est pourtant un pré-requis pour utiliser l’IA générative dans des domaines critiques tels que la santé ou la sécurité. Le post-doctorat explorera ce nouveau sujet à la lumière des outils récents de calibration en commençant pour la génération de données multivariées et étudiera à terme comment l'approche choisie peut être étendue à des données non euclidiennes telles que les graphes. raw.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. 

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.

  • Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) 

  • Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools.

  • Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs).

  • AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst.

  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. 

  • Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.

  • Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.

  • Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.

  • Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team.

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June.


So arbeiten wir

Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs.
Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern.
Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht.
Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release.


Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen.

  • Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern

  • Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite.

  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap.

  • Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess.

  • Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort.

title: Financial Controller (H/F)
description: À propos d'ILLUIN Technology ILLUIN Technology est le leader français de l'IA Générative souveraine et de confiance. Nous développons des modèles de langage (LLM) propriétaires et une plateforme technologique de pointe pour permettre aux entreprises et aux organisations de déployer l'IA générative en toute sécurité, en gardant la maîtrise de leurs données. Adossé au fond privé Seven2, Illuin est entré dans une phase d’investissement et de forte croissance depuis le début de l’année. Vocation à devenir un véritable bras droit du CFO sur les sujets de pilotage économique, vous évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique et agile dans un contexte de structuration où vous devrez faire preuve de polyvalence et être force de proposition afin de contribuer à l’avancement d’un vaste panel de missions tels que : Financial Planning & Analysis Participation aux clôtures mensuelles en relation avec les équipes opérationnelles et l’expert comptable ; Production des reportings financiers, supports et analyses à destination des équipes opérationnelles, des dirigeants et des investisseurs du Groupe ; Elaboration et coordination des budgets et forecasts de l’activité ; Construction et proposition de nouveaux indicateurs de suivi et dashboards afin de fiabiliser le pilotage de l’activité et la prise de décision ; Structuration des processus et participation aux instances de pilotage opérationnels d’Illuin dont l’activité hybride (prestation intellectuelle et produit) offre un large éventail de sujets financiers : comptabilité à l’avancement, taux d’activité, rentabilité projet & client, ROI des investissements Sales & Marketing, suivi et valorisation du Crédit Impôt Recherche… Business Partner financier de l’ensemble des parties prenantes d’une entreprise Être l'interlocuteur(trice) de référence des Leads et équipes opérationnelles (chef de mission, de pôle) et transverses (Sales, Marketing, HR etc) sur les sujets de rentabilité et de pilotage ; Participation à l’élaboration de la stratégie et à l’amélioration continue des Opérations des équipes Sales et Delivery (pricing, contractualisation, staffing, cash collection etc) Sensibiliser les équipes non-financières aux enjeux de gestion (culture de la marge, discipline de facturation, pilotage du recrutement) Data & Process Owner Elaboration et documentation de l’ensemble des processus et de l’outillage financier du Groupe dans un contexte de croissance avec la perspective d’intégration de nouvelles entités ; Mise en place et enrichissement des livrables (dashboard, reportings, outils) pour accompagner la prise de décision. La Finance est garante de la qualité de la donnée permettant une prise de décision éclairée. Des missions ponctuelles variées d’analyses et d’audit en fonction des demandes et décisions de la Direction et des investisseurs du Groupe (M&A, ouvertures de filiales, opérations de financement, déploiement d’outils…) Profil Recherché Il s’agit d’un poste évolutif, à la fois du fait de la croissance et de l’ambition du Groupe mais aussi de la variété des chantiers rencontrés laissant ainsi la place à l’expression des appétences de chacun. Diplômé/e d’une Grande école ou d’un Master spécialisé en Finance des Entreprises (Contrôle de gestion, audit…), Une première expérience solide en Finance au sein d’une direction financière ou en cabinet de conseil/audit, Notions et curiosité appréciées sur les outils d’automatisation, l’IA appliquée à la Finance et le traitement de la donnée, Maîtrise d’Excel / Google Sheets à un niveau avancé. Nous recherchons un profil autonome et force de proposition faisant preuve d’une grande rigueur. Vous devrez faire preuve de curiosité, de polyvalence et d’une capacité d’adaptation pour évoluer sur plusieurs sujets de front demandant un regard critique. Ce que propose le poste Un rôle à fort impact et forte visibilité en lien direct avec la direction et l’ensemble des acteurs de la trajectoire d’Illuin Un coaching et une montée en compétence rapide assurée par le CFO donnant une trajectoire d’évolution claire vers des postes à responsabilité autours du pilotage de la performance financière ; La possibilité de construire son propre périmètre et sa fonction de zéro. raw.title: Customer Success Manager Grands Comptes - Cabinets comptables H/F (en télétravail depuis Rennes)
raw.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Business Recruiter (30min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Sophie Parachey, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Sophie et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

  • Dernier entretien avec Arnaud Bernard (Head of Grands Comptes)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

It is a rare opportunity to build a deep, strategic partnership with some of the biggest companies in France, shaping how they plan, forecast and make decisions across their global organisation.

 


What you'll do
 

  • Own global responsibility for 5 strategic pursuit accounts among the CAC40 and SBF120, headquartered in France

  • Build and execute a multi-year account strategy and territory plan designed to land new business and expand Pigment's footprint across functions, business units and geographies

  • Engage C-level and executive decision-makers to position Pigment through value-based selling, business case definition, ROI analysis, references and market data

  • Lead complex, often multinational, sales cycles from first conversation through to close, coordinating stakeholders across the customer's global organisation

  • Coordinate internal teams: Solutions Consultants, Marketing, Business Development, Customer Success, Partnerships and Executives to drive a unified account strategy

  • Partner with system integrators and services partners to define and deliver the technical and business delivery plan

  • Build lasting relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders across Finance, HR, Supply Chain and beyond

  • Generate and grow your own pipeline through creative, persistent prospecting within your named accounts

  • Forecast sales revenue and activity accurately, while building sustainable, satisfied customers

  • Evangelise the Pigment vision through product demonstrations, in-market events and account-specific initiatives


    • Who you are

  • You have a consistent track record of selling complex enterprise software or platforms to C-level executives within large, global accounts

  • You have experience defining and executing an account strategy and territory plan for a small portfolio of top-tier, complex accounts

  • You have a strong point of view on industry trends and are able to build a narrative around digital transformation, planning and decision-making

  • You are comfortable navigating large matrix organisations and coordinating stakeholders across geographies and business units

  • You are able to sell both a business application and the deployment of an underlying platform

  • You have strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to grow and nurture executive relationships over time

  • You forecast accurately and consistently achieve your revenue goals

  • You are able to negotiate complex, often multi-stakeholder, deals

  • You are a self-starter with a strong drive to succeed and a comfort with risk and ambiguity

  • You convey leadership, authority and confidence in every interaction: written, oral and in presentations

  • You are passionate about our mission at Pigment and the value it can bring to our clients

  • You have a proven track record of sustained success (President's Club, Chairman's Club)

  • You are fluent in French and English
